runs.text: Paul’s Greeting to the Ephesians
Revelation 2:1–7
Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God,
runs.originalText: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God,

runs.text: To the saints in Ephesus,
runs.originalText: To the saints in Ephesus,

runs.text: the faithful in Christ Jesus:
runs.originalText: the faithful in Christ Jesus:

runs.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
runs.originalText: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

runs.text: Spiritual Blessings
Romans 8:28–34
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
runs.originalText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.

runs.text: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence. In love
runs.originalText: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence. In love

runs.text: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,
runs.originalText: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,

runs.text: to the praise of His glorious grace, which He has freely given us in the Beloved One.
runs.originalText: to the praise of His glorious grace, which He has freely given us in the Beloved One.

runs.text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
runs.originalText: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace

runs.text: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.
runs.originalText: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.

runs.text: And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ
runs.originalText: And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ

runs.text: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ.
runs.originalText: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ.

runs.text: In Him we were also chosen as God’s own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,
runs.originalText: In Him we were also chosen as God’s own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,

runs.text: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would be for the praise of His glory.
runs.originalText: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would be for the praise of His glory.

runs.text: And in Him, having heard and believed the word of truth—the gospel of your salvation—you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
runs.originalText: And in Him, having heard and believed the word of truth — the gospel of your salvation — you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

runs.text: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession, to the praise of His glory.
runs.originalText: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession, to the praise of His glory.

runs.text: Spiritual Wisdom
1 Corinthians 2:6–16
For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,
runs.originalText: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,

runs.text: I have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,
runs.originalText: I have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,

runs.text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
runs.originalText: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.

runs.text: I ask that the eyes of your heart
runs.originalText: I ask that the eyes of your heart

runs.text: may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,
runs.originalText: may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,

runs.text: and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,
runs.originalText: and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe.  These are  in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,

runs.text: which He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,
runs.originalText: which He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,

runs.text: far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in the present age but also in the one to come.
runs.originalText: far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in the present age but also in the one to come.

runs.text: And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,
runs.originalText: And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,

runs.text: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
runs.originalText: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
